messages:
mike: quick idea — create a single "Ownership Hub" for post-incident actions. one page + tiny tracker to avoid fragmented spreadsheets. propose: (1) a compact timeline template, (2) 15m weekly follow-up sync, (3) rotating 'closure owner' role. thoughts?

carla: sounds promising. does the timeline capture owners + hard dates?

mike: yep. minimal fields so it actually gets filled. example snippet below — use as the canonical copy in /docs/incidents.

mike: ```
Timeline template:
- Incident ID:
- Short summary (1 line):
- RCA owner:
- Remediation owner:
- Priority (P0/P1/P2):
- Target complete (YYYY-MM-DD):
- Current status (open/in-progress/blocked/done):
- Blockers / notes:
- Verification plan / success criteria:
- Related incidents / recurrence note:
```

james: add one more: "regression gate" or "post-change eval" so we don't ship fix and forget. e.g., metric + 7-day check.

tara: i'll add a docs page and a short template in the handbook. can we call the doc "post-incident ownership hub" and put the tracker link at top?

incident-bot: Reminder: 2 action items overdue for INC-2021 — please reconcile before next sync.

carla: i'll migrate the current open postmortems into the tracker this week. volunteering to be initial closure owner for backlog. target migration done by 2101234620 (end of week). @mike please add me to the tracker. :thumbsup:

james: i'll prototype a tiny query to surface recurring incident patterns (group by signature + subsystem). can run weekly and dump csv into the hub. target prototype by 2101234700.

mike: great. weekly sync -> Mondays 10:00 PT, 15m. invite: oncall rotation + rc owners + docs + pg. agenda: quick unblock, overdue items, one recurrence highlight.

tara: noted, will create calendar and doc anchor, and add a short checklist for the rotation (IC handoff -> triage -> schedule RCA -> assign remediation -> set target).

carla: i put initial assignments in the tracker: 4 items to owners, two blockers flagged for infra help.

james: for recurrence detection: propose fields in tracker "recurrence_count" and "last_occurrence" so we can prioritize repeated issues.

mike: finalizing list of immediate actions:
- migrate backlog into tracker (carla) — due 2101234620
- docs page + calendar + rotation checklist (tara) — due 2101234590
- recurrence prototype + weekly job (james) — due 2101234700
- reconcile overdue actions for INC-2021 (all owners) — before next sync

mike: thanks all — will post the hub link when docs page is live. let's keep follow-ups light and actionable. :rocket:
